workload_user_confirmed: User confirmed and reconfirmed matching connected Pods views, same cluster/namespace and Pod count, both visible, no logs/terminals/forwards/inspectors. Cluster identity and exact Pod count not retained. Accessibility access denied; view equivalence not independently inspected.
method: 1 Hz proc_pid_rusage v2 physical footprint; responsibility owner plus recursive descendants; Mach-timebase converted CPU-time deltas, 100% = one core
limitations: Workload equivalence is user-confirmed, not independently inspected; exact row count not retained.
Three consecutive windows in one session, not independent trials or representative cluster sizes.
Both apps run concurrently with existing profiles and unrelated host activity; window dimensions/occlusion not instrumented.
Different application uptimes, polling, caching and background work are not normalized.
CPU uses Mach-timebase converted counters for stable identities. Short-lived processes between samples may be missed.
Process listings and counters are sequential, not an atomic snapshot; footprint sums are per-process charges, not unique system pages.
No startup, API/refresh latency, interaction/FPS, sustained load, battery, GPU utilization or feature-parity measurement.
summary_method: 180 interval-end memory samples; pooled median/p95; CPU summed over three consecutive 60-second windows, excluding inter-window gaps. Postprocessed using stable process identities only; all identities were constant within each measured window.
